AddDiskDialog.title: Add {{model}} to array
AddDiskDialog.lockedWarning: This device appears to be locked/in use by another process - adding it may fail.
AddDiskDialog.noPartitionWarning: No partition detected - it'll be assigned and cleared as a raw disk.
AddDiskDialog.arrayRunningWarning: The array is currently running - it'll be stopped automatically when this item's turn comes up.
AddDiskDialog.assignDesc: Parity has to be at least as large as your biggest data disk. A second parity disk is optional - it protects against two disk failures at once instead of one.
AddDiskDialog.dataSlotNote: The first free data slot (1-28) is used automatically.
AddDiskDialog.slotTaken: That slot already has a disk assigned.
AddDiskDialog.addedRunning: Added to the queue - starting now.
AddDiskDialog.addedQueued: Added to the queue - will start once the current operation finishes.
AddDiskDialog.watchProgress: Watch progress on the Disk Queue card.

BootDiskDetailPanel.title: Boot Disk
BootDiskDetailPanel.smartLoadFailed: Failed to read SMART data for this device.
BootDiskDetailPanel.noSmartData: No SMART data available for this disk.

CacheReplaceDialog.title: Replace missing cache mirror member
CacheReplaceDialog.replaceWarning: Runs btrfs's own online replace against the missing mirror member - any data on the new device is destroyed. The cache stays usable (single-disk, no redundancy) while this runs.
CacheReplaceDialog.finished: Replacement finished - the mirror should be healthy again.

CacheSection.noCacheDesc: No cache mirror set up. A cache pool is a mirrored pair of disks that pool writes land on first - a scheduled mover then drains them onto the parity-protected array. Requires exactly two disks.

CacheSetupDialog.title: Set up cache mirror
CacheSetupDialog.formatWarning: This formats both devices as a single btrfs RAID1 filesystem - any existing data on either device is destroyed. Only devices with no recognized filesystem or mounted partition are offered below.
CacheSetupDialog.pickTwoDevices: Pick two different devices for the mirrored pair.
CacheSetupDialog.onlyOneDevice: Only one unassigned device found - a mirror needs two.
CacheSetupDialog.lockedWarning: This device appears to be locked/in use - setup may fail.
CacheSetupDialog.watchProgress: Watch progress on the Disk Queue card.
CacheSetupDialog.addedRunning: Added to the queue - starting now.
CacheSetupDialog.addedQueued: Added to the queue - will start once the current operation finishes.

DiskDetailPanel.noSmartData: No SMART data available for this disk.
DiskDetailPanel.noRawAttributes: No raw attribute table for this disk.
DiskDetailPanel.restorableNotice: This disk was unassigned but the array hasn't been started since - the change isn't committed yet and this disk's identity is still intact.
DiskDetailPanel.restoreTitle: Cancels the pending unassign and puts this disk back exactly as it was - the array hasn't started since, so nothing was actually committed yet.
DiskDetailPanel.droppableNotice: This disk is permanently disabled and no longer part of the array - it still shows up here and counts toward DEGRADED because this driver keeps removed slots as placeholders rather than shrinking the array automatically. Reconfiguring drops it from the topology for good, at the cost of a full parity rebuild.
DiskDetailPanel.reconfigureTitle: Permanently drops this slot from the array topology and rebuilds parity to match - there's no undo.
DiskDetailPanel.formatDiskTitle: Creates a fresh XFS filesystem on this disk so it can join the array.
DiskDetailPanel.mountDiskTitle: Makes this disk's existing filesystem accessible at /mnt/disk{{slot}}.
DiskDetailPanel.forceFormatTitle: Wipes this disk's existing (non-array) filesystem and formats it as XFS - destroys everything on it, with no undo.
DiskDetailPanel.formatWarning: Detected an existing {{fsType}} filesystem on this disk - formatted over it anyway.
DiskDetailPanel.emptyDiskTitle: Moves this disk's files onto other array disks, then offers to remove it from the array once it's empty.
DiskDetailPanel.spinDownTitle: Spins this disk down to save power while it's idle.
DiskDetailPanel.replaceDiskTitle: Swaps in a genuinely different physical disk for this slot - the array rebuilds this disk's data from parity onto the new one.
DiskDetailPanel.unassignDiskTitle: Removes this disk from the array. Its data is emulated from parity until you add a replacement, which then rebuilds it back.

EmptyDiskDialog.title: Empty {{label}} (slot {{slot}})
EmptyDiskDialog.checking: Checking whether the data fits on the other disks…
EmptyDiskDialog.nothingToMove: Nothing to move - this disk isn't part of any configured pool, so there's no file this tool knows how to relocate.
EmptyDiskDialog.unmanagedBytesNote: It still has {{size}} of real data on it. Removing it from the array only detaches the slot - that data stays on the physical disk, it just won't be reachable through the array anymore.
EmptyDiskDialog.goStraightToRemove: Since there's nothing this tool can move, you can go straight to stopping the array and removing this disk from it.
EmptyDiskDialog.unmanagedNotUnderPool: {{size}} on this disk isn't under any pool configured for it - this won't be moved, and needs handling manually (see Browse) before this disk is truly empty.
EmptyDiskDialog.copyVerifyRemove: This copies every file to its new disk, verifies it, then removes the original - it can take a long time for real data and runs in the background. Watch progress on the Empty Disk card.

ReplaceDiskDialog.title: Replace {{label}} (slot {{slot}})
ReplaceDiskDialog.confirmWarning: This is for swapping in a genuinely different physical disk - not for temporarily detaching this one. Once you pick a replacement disk on the next step, this slot's current identity is cleared and the array runs degraded until the new disk finishes rebuilding from parity. There's no undo past that point. If you just clicked here by accident, close this dialog - nothing has happened yet.
ReplaceDiskDialog.selectDesc: Physically install the replacement disk, then pick it below. Not seeing it? It may not be connected yet, or another slot still claims its identity.
ReplaceDiskDialog.watchProgress: Watch progress on the Parity Check card.

ShrinkArrayDialog.title: Reconfigure array without {{label}} (slot {{slot}})
ShrinkArrayDialog.done: Array reconfigured - slot {{slot}} no longer exists in the array. Parity is rebuilding.
ShrinkArrayDialog.warning1: This stops the array, reloads the storage driver, and rebuilds the array's configuration without slot {{slot}} - then rebuilds parity from scratch. It does not touch real files on any disk you're keeping.
ShrinkArrayDialog.warning2: The driver reload step can leave the array briefly down if interrupted - this can take a while and shouldn't be cancelled partway. If it fails, the error will include the exact command to recover manually.
